static_traits.name: Luo Lan
static_traits.family_status: No immediate family members, living alone
static_traits.social_status: Has a few car-savvy friends to talk with, but has not yet shared emotions with them; friendships affected by avoiding repairing cars together
static_traits.medical_history: No prior psychotherapy or similar problem history; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly cooperative, neutral tone, able to describe Anxiety and distress specifically; thinking shows catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and self-labeling features

basic_info.main_problem: I feel I am the worst Mechanic ever, struggling even with simple tasks like changing car bulbs, which makes me avoid car repair; strong helplessness appears every time I try to repair a vehicle (a few times per week).
basic_info.core_demands: These helpless feelings affect my self-esteem and hinder me from repairing cars effectively, so I seek counseling, hoping to improve this state.
growth_experiences: A few months ago I started having difficulty with basic mechanical tasks (like failing to change car bulbs), triggering marked helplessness and avoidance behaviors, Decline in work performance, damaged daily interests and car-repair activities with friends.

A few months ago, after seeing news about a home burglary, began to strongly worry that the doll collection would be stolen; when away from home or working outside, frequently fearful, sleep worsened, social activities decreased, and consequently increased home security and avoided related news.

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough / insufficient ability

special_situations.event: Failing to successfully change car bulbs
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot do even simple tasks well, it proves I am incompetent / I am the worst Mechanic
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces or avoids car-repair attempts, turning instead to watching tutorials and asking friends for help, but overall lowers practice frequency
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot even do this; I am the worst Mechanic ever

special_situations.event: Whenever attempting to repair the vehicle (several times a week)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Trying again will fail and further prove I am incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Simply not doing it or delaying, to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will definitely mess up; might as well not do it

special_situations.event: Seeing news about theft or burglary or hearing news of a break-in
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I leave home, burglars will very likely break in and steal my collection
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increasing home security, avoiding related news, reducing outings and socializing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: As soon as I leave home, the doll will be stolen

special_situations.event: Thinking about the Safety of my collection while Working outside or away from home
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Must stay home to ensure Safety, otherwise something will definitely go wrong
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stays home as much as possible and cancels social activities to 'guard' the collection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Something will go wrong if I am not home; I have to guard it

core_conflict.wish: Longing to maintain competence and a sense of control, protecting the safety of important things (collections)
core_conflict.fear: Fears failure being judged, fears intrusion and losing important items after leaving home
defense_goal: Reduces failure and risk by avoiding car repair and socializing and strengthening security, to maintain a sense of safety and self-esteem

object_relations.self_representation: An incompetent Mechanic prone to failure
object_relations.object_representation: Others (peers / friends) are judges, more capable than oneself

object_relations.self_representation: A fragile guardian who must personally watch over the collection
object_relations.object_representation: The outside world is a dangerous intruder / threat

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When leaving home or discussing/seeing news about theft
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Views the outside world as a threat that could intrude at any time; believes leaving home almost certainly leads to theft
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a steady, Empathetic tone, acknowledging their concerns, inviting them to do specific risk assessments and small-step behavioral experiments together, focusing on factual data.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When needing to complete a mechanical repair task or recall a failure experience
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equating one failure with overall helplessness, assuming further attempts will only prove 'I am incompetent'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using gentle inquiry and specification questions, encouraging records of objective performance and small-step attempts, avoiding evaluation, focusing on observable evidence to challenge conclusions.

manifestations: Fear of theft making me dare not leave home, canceling socializing and outings
No longer repairing cars to avoid failure
Living alone with reduced interaction with car-enthusiast friends
Tends to stay home to 'guard' the collection
Self-evaluation as 'the worst Mechanic' shaking professional self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Imposes rigid rules on oneself such as 'I must be home to be safe'
Treating 'one failure = overall helplessness' as an absolute standard

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Being overly cautious and tending toward avoidance when attempting tasks

positive_force: Has a vocational training background and experience in auto repair
Willing to try behavioral experiments and open to exploration
Has taken practical measures to improve home security
Has car-domain friends as a resource to ask for help
negative_force: Catastrophizing and future-predicting tendencies, overestimating negative outcomes
Overgeneralization and self-labeling, causing Impaired self-esteem
Avoidance behaviors Reinforcing Anxiety and the 'helplessness' belief
Persistent vigilance toward external threats restricts life and socializing

antecedent: When trying to repair the vehicle
Recalls recent failures at basic tasks (such as failing to change a light bulb)

target_behavior.function: Escaping failure and shame, temporarily protecting self-esteem and easing Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance drops markedly, daily interests and socializing impaired

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Anxiety when leaving home and reduced outings/socializing to 'guard' the doll collection
antecedent: Seeing news about theft or home burglary
Thinking about the Safety of my collection while Working outside or away from home
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic Interpretation and future prediction of theft risk, linking leaving home with 'something will definitely go wrong'
